questions.question: Telemetry default
questions.answer: No ADE telemetry: a bounded search of the pinned source (799fa96) found no analytics or crash-reporting client sending data to the vendor. The telemetry matches are not vendor telemetry: shared/memory-telemetry.ts and shared/timeline-delivery-telemetry.ts only feed in-process, non-persisted counters inside the user's own daemon and server; X-Platform/X-App-Version headers go into the auth audit_log of the server the user signs in to (self-hosted or the hosted account service) as login audit records; and --disable-telemetry is passed to the third-party Antigravity CLI to switch its telemetry off. Other matches are audio amplitude fields and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 for child npm processes. Consistent with the privacy page stating no third-party analytics.

The X-Platform, X-App-Version and X-Bundle-Version request headers are written by server/src/routes/auth.ts into the audit_log table of whichever server the user signs in to (their self-hosted server or the hosted app.im.codes account service), as auth audit records rather than an analytics feed. shared/agy-agent.ts defines --disable-telemetry, which the daemon passes to the third-party Google Antigravity (agy) CLI to turn that tool's telemetry off.
